comment: Section title in a sentry or emplacement stratagem's editor: which projectile its turret fires (HD2Runtime 0.30.2 projectile host swap)
Badge: the host is a sentry (aims by itself)
Badge: the host is an emplacement (aimed by the player)

en: Applies to every {0} on your machine, teammates' too. Other players' machines keep the stock round.
zh: 作用于你这台电脑上的每一个 {0}，包括队友的。其他玩家的电脑仍使用原版弹药。
comment: {0}: stratagem name. The swap is type-level: each machine simulates turret shots from its own data
Column header: the round the sentry or emplacement fires natively
Row label: direct damage of the round
Table cell: the SDK publishes no value for the chosen round

en: A sentry aims for its own round. A round with another speed or drop may miss moving targets, and a flat round from a mortar may miss entirely.
zh: 哨戒炮按其自身弹药瞄准。速度或下坠不同的弹药可能打不中移动目标，迫击炮发射平射弹药则可能完全打不中。
comment: Shown before a round is chosen for a sentry

en: This sentry still aims for its own round, not for {0}. If the speed or drop differ it may miss moving targets; a flat round from a mortar may miss entirely.
zh: 此哨戒炮仍按其自身弹药瞄准，而不是按 {0}。速度或下坠不同时可能打不中移动目标；迫击炮发射平射弹药则可能完全打不中。
comment: {0}: the chosen round. Warning shown while a sentry fires another round

en: Emplacements are aimed by the player: a round with another speed or drop lands elsewhere than the sight suggests.
zh: 炮台由玩家瞄准：速度或下坠不同的弹药落点会与准星所示不同。
comment: Note on an emplacement's fired round
